mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('published', 'disabled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'published' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS publishedCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'disabled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS disabledCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('published', 'disabled') THEN use_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalUseCount FROM ai_agent WHERE del_flag = '0'

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN evaluate = 'like' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 3) END FROM ai_chat_record WHERE evaluate IS NOT NULL AND (del_flag IS NULL OR del_flag = '0')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_collect c INNER JOIN ai_agent a ON a.id = c.target_id AND a.del_flag = '0' WHERE c.collect_type = 'agent'

SELECT a.tenant_id AS tenantId, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS agentCount, IFNULL(SUM(a.use_count), 0) AS totalUseCount, IFNULL( ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.evaluate = 'like' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.evaluate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 3), 0 ) AS avgSatisfaction, IFNULL( ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.evaluate = 'like' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.evaluate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 3), 0 ) AS avgAccuracy, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS totalFavorites FROM ai_agent a LEFT JOIN ai_chat_record r ON r.agent_id = a.id LEFT JOIN ai_collect c ON c.target_id = a.id AND c.collect_type = 'agent' WHERE a.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY a.tenant_id
ORDER BY avgAccuracy DESC ORDER BY totalFavorites DESC ORDER BY avgSatisfaction DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_agent a WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.status = 'published'
AND (a.tags IS NULL OR NOT JSON_CONTAINS(a.tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{excludeTag}), '$'))
AND ()

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_agent a WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.status = 'published' AND a.source = #{source}
AND (a.tags IS NULL OR NOT JSON_CONTAINS(a.tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{excludeTag}), '$'))

SELECT r.agent_id AS agentId, a.name, a.avatar, COUNT(DISTINCT IFNULL(r.conversation_id, r.record_id)) AS useCount FROM ai_chat_record r INNER JOIN ai_agent a ON a.id = r.agent_id AND a.del_flag = '0' AND a.status = 'published' WHERE r.agent_id IS NOT NULL AND r.username = #{username} AND (r.del_flag IS NULL OR r.del_flag = '0') GROUP BY r.agent_id, a.name, a.avatar ORDER BY useCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.agent_id AS agentId, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.evaluate = 'like' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 3) END AS satisfaction FROM ai_chat_record r WHERE r.evaluate IS NOT NULL AND (r.del_flag IS NULL OR r.del_flag = '0') AND r.agent_id IN #{id} GROUP BY r.agent_id
SELECT id, name FROM ai_dataset WHERE del_flag = '0' AND id IN #{id}
